Pointblank checks your tables for the problems that matter (missing values, out-of-range numbers,
malformed text, duplicate rows) and **reports what it finds** in tables that analysts, engineers,
and stakeholders can all read.

## A validation, one part at a time {.pbh-heading}

A validation is a table, a plan of checks, and a report. Step through this one to see what each
part adds, with the new lines of code highlighted.

::::: {.pbh-stepper #pbh-stepper}

:::: {.pbh-step}
[Data]{.pbh-step-name}

Start with a table: Polars, Pandas, a DuckDB or Spark table, a database table, or a CSV or Parquet
file. [`pb.preview()`](`preview`) shows its first and last rows and its column types.

```{python}
import pointblank as pb

small_table = pb.load_dataset("small_table")

pb.preview(small_table)
```
::::

:::: {.pbh-step}
[Plan]{.pbh-step-name}

Say what good data looks like, one check per step. There are checks for values, text patterns,
sets, missing values, duplicates, row counts, schemas, and more. Before the checks are run, the
report shows the plan.

```{python}
(
    pb.Validate(
        data=small_table,
        tbl_name="small_table",
        label="Checks on the sales data",
    )
    .col_vals_gt(columns="d", value=1000)
    .col_vals_not_null(columns="c")
    .col_vals_regex(columns="b", pattern=r"^\d-[a-z]{3}-\d{3}$")
    .col_vals_in_set(columns="f", set=["low", "mid", "high"])
    .rows_distinct()
)
```
::::

:::: {.pbh-step}
[Thresholds]{.pbh-step-name}

Decide how much failure is too much. Thresholds set the share of failing rows that counts as a
warning, an error, or a critical problem, and actions can run when one is reached.

```{python}
(
    pb.Validate(
        data=small_table,
        tbl_name="small_table",
        label="Checks on the sales data",
        thresholds=pb.Thresholds(warning=0.05, error=0.10, critical=0.15),
    )
    .col_vals_gt(columns="d", value=1000)
    .col_vals_not_null(columns="c")
    .col_vals_regex(columns="b", pattern=r"^\d-[a-z]{3}-\d{3}$")
    .col_vals_in_set(columns="f", set=["low", "mid", "high"])
    .rows_distinct()
)
```
::::

:::: {.pbh-step}
[Report]{.pbh-step-name}

Run the checks with [`interrogate()`](`Validate.interrogate`). The report shows every step: how
many rows passed and failed, which thresholds were reached, and a CSV of the failing rows. With
`brief=True`, each step also says in plain words what it checks.

```{python}
(
    pb.Validate(
        data=small_table,
        tbl_name="small_table",
        label="Checks on the sales data",
        brief=True,
        thresholds=pb.Thresholds(warning=0.05, error=0.10, critical=0.15),
    )
    .col_vals_gt(columns="d", value=1000)
    .col_vals_not_null(columns="c")
    .col_vals_regex(columns="b", pattern=r"^\d-[a-z]{3}-\d{3}$")
    .col_vals_in_set(columns="f", set=["low", "mid", "high"])
    .rows_distinct()
    .interrogate()
)
```
::::

:::::

```{python}
)
```

## See exactly what failed {.pbh-heading}

A failing step is a starting point, not a dead end. Open any step in a report of its own, pull out
the rows that failed, or split the table into its passing and failing rows.

::::: {.pbh-switch #pbh-switch}

:::: {.pbh-option}
[A step's own report]{.pbh-option-name}

The rows where `c` is missing, with the failing values highlighted.

```{python}
validation.get_step_report(i=2)
```
::::

:::: {.pbh-option}
[The failing rows]{.pbh-option-name}

The rows where `d` isn't over 1,000, as a table of their own.

```{python}
pb.preview(validation.get_data_extracts(i=1, frame=True))
```
::::

:::: {.pbh-option}
[Split the table]{.pbh-option-name}

Every row that failed any step, ready for a quarantine table.

```{python}
pb.preview(validation.get_sundered_data(type="fail"))
```
::::

## Runs where your data lives {.pbh-heading}

Pointblank works through [Narwhals](https://narwhals-dev.github.io/narwhals/) and
[Ibis](https://ibis-project.org), so the same plan runs unchanged on DataFrames and in databases,
and the checks happen where the data is.

::: {.pbh-backends}
[Polars]{.pbh-backend}
[Pandas]{.pbh-backend}
[PyArrow]{.pbh-backend}
[DuckDB]{.pbh-backend}
[PySpark]{.pbh-backend}
[Snowflake]{.pbh-backend}
[BigQuery]{.pbh-backend}
[Databricks]{.pbh-backend}
[PostgreSQL]{.pbh-backend}
[MySQL]{.pbh-backend}
[SQL Server]{.pbh-backend}
[SQLite]{.pbh-backend}
[CSV and Parquet]{.pbh-backend}
:::
